acquisition.networkBoundary: Connected agent inference outside network-off geometry containers. Agents may only read their packet; progressive replies supplied by coordinator from frozen host outputs.
acquisition.limits: one packet generation per arm, five fixed diagnostic cases; progressive two valid calls maximum per case
acquisition.confounds: Raw vs summary has different shape information; summary instruction explicitly labels outer enclosures. Tools include task-conditioned computation. Only eager vs progressive holds the available tool facts constant. No population reliability claim.
